title: India pumps 5,000 tonne of diesel into Bangladesh amid Iran war strain
desc: Amid war-driven energy strain, India has begun pumping 5,000 tonnes of diesel to Bangladesh through the cross-border Friendship Pipeline as part of an annual agreement to supply 180,000 tonnes of the fuel. The first consignment on Tuesday marks the start of the five-year-long supply plan, and could be seen as a sign of bilateral energy ties stabilising after Sheikh Hasina's exit.
